subject.title: feat(sandbox): add skipSkillsSync config option to suppress skill sync

question: Should Docker sandboxes expose a public `skipSkillsSync` mode, and if so what explicit contract must bind host-resolved skill eligibility to the files and paths supplied inside the container?
rationale: The choice determines a permanent public configuration surface and changes which skill instructions are trusted across the sandbox boundary; code review cannot choose that product and security contract safely.

options.title: Require an explicit deployment contract
options.body: Accept the optimization only after the configured or prepared runtime identifies the sandbox skill root and guarantees that advertised names and locations correspond to the deployed files.

options.title: Keep canonical synchronization
options.body: Decline the new setting and retain copied or materialized skills as the single supported path, avoiding another configuration and trust mode.

options.title: Accept operator-managed convention
options.body: Ship the boolean with `/workspace/skills` and container contents entirely operator-managed, explicitly accepting missing or divergent skill-content risk.

recommendation.title: Require an explicit deployment contract
recommendation.body: Accept the optimization only after the configured or prepared runtime identifies the sandbox skill root and guarantees that advertised names and locations correspond to the deployed files.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent related sandbox skill-prompt and security-path work makes this the strongest available routing signal for the cross-boundary product decision.
